text: E5 was the first model to outperform the BM25 baseline on the BEIR retrieval benchmark without using any labeled data [S1]. Specifically, E5-PTbase outperformed the classic BM25 algorithm by 1.2 points when averaged over all 15 datasets [S4]. Regarding M3-Embedding, its sparse retrieval functionality outperforms BM25 on the MIRACL dataset [S6]. This indicates that the learned weights in M3 are significantly better than those calculated by BM25 [S6].
